name: kannon-quote
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv tesseract-ocr
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -U pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Kannon Quote API for Desktop at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (password from config/shop_rates.yaml)
